body.title: Add the additive ToolResultEvent to the TurnEvent union
body.summary: In vscode-plugin/src/chat/stream-events.ts add the additive union member ToolResultEvent { readonly kind:'tool-result'; readonly turnId: string; readonly command?: string; readonly output: string; readonly exitCode?: number } and add 'tool-result' to TURN_EVENT_KINDS. No existing member changes shape.

Existing event kinds are structurally unchanged (k1/lc1)
